parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a magnetic field.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
A particle has mass $m$, charge $+q$ and speed $v$.

The particle enters a uniform magnetic field of flux density $B$ such that, on entry, it is moving normal to the magnetic field, as shown in Fig. 8.1.

{{figure:figure_8_1.png}}

The direction of the magnetic field is perpendicular to, and into, the plane of the paper.
parts.text: On Fig. 8.1, draw the path of the particle through, and beyond, the region of the magnetic field.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
There is a force acting on the particle, causing it to accelerate.
Explain why the speed of the particle on leaving the magnetic field is $v$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The particle in (b) loses an electron so that its charge becomes $+2q$. Its change in mass is negligible.

Determine, in terms of $v$, the initial speed of the particle such that its path through the magnetic field is unchanged. Explain your working.
